profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | React, Next.js, TypeScript | Java/Spring, Go, Python
profile.summary: Software Engineer with five years of production experience building internal platforms, LLM-powered tools, and data-driven interfaces. Focused on self-service enablement, cost optimization, and bridging the gap between engineering systems and business decision-making. Hands-on experience integrating AI and agentic systems into production environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered a self-service database portal that eliminated ticket-based requests for database provisioning, scaling, and decommissioning across Target's 5,000+ person engineering organization. Developed using a Java-based state machine orchestrating lifecycle events across microservices via Kafka, with a Next.js UI and Java API control plane.

Built a Gemini-powered natural language querying service that let business leaders query infrastructure data in plain English, eliminating ad-hoc data requests to engineers. Developed using an internal LLM API, Hive database, and React-based UI.

Developed a standalone cloud cost estimation web application that enabled engineering teams to model provider-specific cloud costs in minutes, improving budgeting accuracy and reducing overprovisioning across services. Built with a Go API, Python ETL pipeline, and TypeScript/Next.js UI.

Built the React dashboard for an infrastructure scoring system that surfaced ~$6k/month in wasted spend, giving engineering teams visibility into inefficient resource usage.

Built Cypress and Jest test suites for critical workflows to ensure reliability and prevent regressions.

Mentored 15+ engineers across levels in React and Docker as a pod coach and colleague, accelerating onboarding and improving team-wide code quality.

Supported Society of Women Engineers, Target Women in STEM, and Target Tech Kids through panels and mentoring early-career students in STEM.

projects.title: Forgeyard
projects.description:
Designed and built a containerized agentic development platform with a compliant MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0), a Go-based Docker control plane, and a sandboxed HTTP execution API. A Claude Code agent autonomously provisions isolated app environments without host filesystem or Docker access.
